blocks.text: Stack ek saada data structure hai jis mein items sirf ek sire se jore ya nikale jate hain; is sire ko “top” kehte hain. Item dalna (insertion) aur nikalna (deletion) dono top par hi hote hain. Stack Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle (usool / qaida) par chalta hai: jo item sab se aakhir mein dala gaya, wohi sab se pehle nikalta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Plates ka dher sochiye: nayi plate oopar rakhi jati hai aur uthate waqt bhi oopar wali plate hi pehle uthti hai.

blocks.prompt: Stack ki definition (tareef) bataiye aur LIFO principle samjhaiye (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Stack items ka aisa collection (majmooa) hai jis mein dalna (push) aur nikalna (pop) sirf top par hota hai. LIFO ka matlab hai jo item aakhir mein push hua woh sab se pehle pop hota hai, jaise plates ke dher mein sab se oopar wali plate jo aakhir mein rakhi gayi thi.

items: Stack: ek hi khula sira (top); Last-In, First-Out (LIFO).
